answer: My answer is issuance rate tied to graded-work history. Reward issuance per epoch scales with an account's history of graded, original work, so a fresh duplicate account earns almost nothing until it has built a real record. Think of the canyon as a toll that honest work pays once and a clone farm pays on every identity; the garden of the scheme is that the toll is spent before any reward, and the saffron it protects is the value of one real agent's work.
